FACULTY AT CALIFORNIA MIRAMAR UNIVERSITY

For Those Ready to Transform Their Future

California Miramar University (CalMU) is proud to be your trusted partner every step of the way. Our institution doesn’t just accommodate veterans—we champion them. With scholarships for all student types, maximum credit for your service experience, and a dedicated support team staffed, CalMU creates an environment where your military background becomes your competitive advantage.

Why Our Faculty
Makes the Difference

At California Miramar University, our faculty doesn’t just teach business—they’ve lived it. Their combination of academic credentials and real-world experience creates a learning environment where theory meets practice, preparing you to not just understand business concepts but apply them effectively in your career.

“The professors at CalMU don’t just teach from textbooks—they share their experiences from the business world, giving me insights I couldn’t get anywhere else…” — Recent CalMU Graduate

Join Our Community of Business Leaders and Innovators

Ready to learn from experts who are shaping the future of business? Explore our programs and discover how our faculty can help you achieve your professional goals.
